stances_toward.note: Armenia is still a member in law (the Secretariat says so) but has frozen participation 'at all levels' since February 2024, has not paid contributions for two years (per Lavrov, June 2026), says it will not unfreeze and that it would be 'very pleased' to be expelled. The dataset-derived treaty floor shows allies; the structure is the opposite of alignment. Graded 'neutral' because no other grade describes a member that has withdrawn in practice but not in law. Bond - grievance: the bloc did not act in 2021-23.

stances_toward.note: Founding-era member (since 1994 per the CSTO member list) and host of the Nov 2023 Minsk summit, which Armenia skipped; Russia chairs in 2026 with a summit in Moscow on 11 Nov 2026. The treaty alliance is thin beside the bilateral Union State pact: the CSTO is a political umbrella for Minsk, not its security guarantee. Bond - affinity: the post-Soviet security club.
